title: Internal set actions and normalized precomposition data
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ [def-weil-size-convention], a $\mathcal V$-small category $C$, and a precoverage $J$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For a group sheaf $K:C^{op}\to\mathbf{Grp}_{\mathcal V}$, let $\underline K$ be its underlying set sheaf with internal monoid unit and multiplication given sectionwise by $1$ and group multiplication. Define $\operatorname{SetActions}_J(K)=\operatorname{Mod}(\operatorname{Sh}(C,J),\underline K)$: an object is a set sheaf with a natural left $K$-action satisfying unit and associativity, and an arrow is an equivariant sheaf map. Define its section action by evaluating the action morphism. On the labeled action sites $C_K$ [def-sfb-internal-action-site-basic], a group-presheaf map $\theta:L\to K$ defines the functor $C_L\to C_K$ that fixes base objects and sends $(f,a)$ to $(f,\theta(a))$. For sites $(C,J)$ and $(D,T)$ and $F:D\to C$ whose precomposition preserves sheaves, define the lifted precomposition on sheaves by $M\mapsto F^{op}\circ M$, with the same component maps. If $C$ has finite limits and $J$ is a site for coverings, label change and projection preserve sheaves; their lifted precompositions are called restriction and trivial inflation, respectively, for any coefficient category $A:\operatorname{Type}(\mathcal V+1)$ with homs in $\mathcal V$. For a commutative ring sheaf $R$, define the pulled coefficient by this same precomposition, and write $|M|$ for the underlying set sheaf of a module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. A normalized module pullback for a ringed topos morphism $f$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] is a functor $f^*$, its adjunction with the induced module direct image, and an isomorphism $|f^*M|\cong f^{-1}|M|$ whose Hom correspondence agrees with the given set-sheaf adjunction. For $F$ and $R$, define a precomposition-pullback datum to consist of a ringed morphism with inverse image equal to the lifted precomposition and identity structural map, a normalized additive module pullback preserving finite limits and colimits, sectionwise linear equivalences with the original module sections along $F$, compatible with restrictions, morphisms and the underlying-set comparison, and tensor and regular-unit isomorphisms [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] sending local pure tensors and regular sections to themselves under these equivalences. For a map $\varphi:R\to R'$ of commutative ring sheaves on a site, define a coefficient-change datum to be a ringed morphism $(\mathscr E,R')\to(\mathscr E,R)$ with inverse image equal to the identity and structural map equal to $\varphi$ under that equality. These are definitions of data and section formulas, not assertions that every such datum exists.
